# awsprite

> Hatch a companion that grows only from what you teach it, then take it home.

A companion that never changes is a toy, and one whose growth you cannot see or edit is a black box. Most "AI pet" products are a chat window with a sprite pasted on top -- nothing you taught it persists, and nothing about how it grew is checkable.

## Install

```
pip install awsprite
```

## Use it in 30 seconds

Hatch a companion, teach it something, and watch what it becomes.

## Composes with

- [awdk](https://aitherium.github.io/awdk/) — Build AI agent fleets — 3 lines, any backend, local or cloud.
- [awm](https://aitherium.github.io/awm/) — A portable, scoped agent memory.
- [awnode](https://aitherium.github.io/awnode/) — A lightweight local gateway — bridges your apps to the AI backends you chose.
- [awsh](https://aitherium.github.io/awsh/) — Your terminal answers you -- type a question where a command would go.

## Where it lives

- Repo: https://github.com/Aitherium/awsprite

This repository is mirrored from the AitherOS monorepo by `.github/workflows/sync-awsprite.yml`; hand edits made here are overwritten on the next sync — change the source instead.

Everything Aitherium, in one file for agents: https://aitherium.com/llms.txt
